_comment: Workbook exercise plant-lockout (docs/workbook/plant-lockout.md): the heating plant's warm-weather lockout on the synthetic-hw-plant-lockout plants (generated by CAMBER, no real building), at the default 65 F lockout. boiler_summer_lockout reads the burner firing, hw_pump_summer_lockout the pump's run status; both judge occupied hours on the generic weekday schedule and warn at 5 % / fault at 20 % of running hours above the lockout. The two variant configs, plant-lockout--58f and plant-lockout--75f, set the lockout on boiler_summer_lockout only: the pump rule inherits it.
